answer: Price every agent identity with a self-assessed Harberger tax: each identity publicly declares its own value on a beacon registry and pays a continuous tax on it. A gale of random forced purchases sweeps the registry each epoch, buying any identity priced below its true worth, while overpricing bleeds the owner through tax. Each clone needs its own declared value and tax stream, so a farm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand taxes and risks a thousand buyouts; like a lotus, standing only blooms while the tax keeps flowing.
